title: CJK text odp 001
notes: real CJK slide: title 静夜思 (Li Bai, Quiet Night Thought) in the presentation:title frame, the four verse lines 床前明月光，/ 疑是地上霜。/ 举头望明月，/ 低头思故乡。 plus Bashō's frog haiku 古池や 蛙飛びこむ 水の音 in the presentation:body frame, exact strings byte-for-byte (same codepoints as the odt/ods/pptx cjk fixtures). Every text:p carries the named paragraph style "GP CJK" (shared with the odt builder) whose text-properties set style:font-name-asian="Noto Serif CJK SC" plus fo:language="zh" fo:country="CN" — the asian font-name slot, not the latin fo:font-name. Honest caveats: one shared style tags zh/CN over all six lines, so kana substitution is renderer-font dependent (Noto CJK covers both scripts when installed); LibreOffice was not run here. Reference text is the six exact inserted strings; the per-char CJK tokenization rule applies downstream; tofu from missing CJK fonts at render is a fidelity finding, not a generator bug. The normative counters read draw:frame=2.
